pages.text: A large syringe that can hold doses of potions. Perfect for doctors!$(br2)$(3)$(l)Special:$() A potion effect can be inserted by right-clicking a potion on it. It is then delivered over 3 uses by attacking enemies or using it (each with a third of the base potion's duration).
Combine The Sting and a Crusader Crossbolt in a Totem Lathe.
